## TemplateEngine.validateBlockGMessageRich() method

Validates all aspects of a template: block names, scopes, block format, block positioning, and base attributes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static validateBlockGMessageRich(html: string): {
        valid: boolean;
        errors: Array<{
            line: number;
            message: string;
        }>;
    };
```

An object with a `valid` boolean and a combined `errors` array containing line numbers and descriptive messages for every violation found

## Remarks

This is a convenience method that runs all validators in order:

1. [TemplateEngine.validateNamesBlock()](./gramstax.templateengine.validatenamesblock.md) — checks that all tags are known 2. [TemplateEngine.validateScopes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validatescopes.md) — checks that all interpolation scopes are known 3. [TemplateEngine.validateFormatBlock()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateformatblock.md) — checks self-closing vs regular tag syntax 4. [TemplateEngine.validatePositionsBlock()](./gramstax.templateengine.validatepositionsblock.md) — checks structural nesting rules 5. [TemplateEngine.validateTelegramAttributesBlock()](./gramstax.templateengine.validatetelegramattributesblock.md) — checks required attributes on Telegram Rich HTML tags 6. [TemplateEngine.validateTelegramAttributeValuesBlock()](./gramstax.templateengine.validatetelegramattributevaluesblock.md) — checks value formats on Telegram Rich HTML tag attributes 7. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockGBaseAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockgbaseattributes.md) — checks `<g-base>` block attributes 8. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockGMessageAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockgmessageattributes.md) — checks `<g-message>` block attributes 9. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockGKeyboardAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockgkeyboardattributes.md) — checks `<g-keyboard>` block attributes 10. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockGMediaAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockgmediaattributes.md) — checks `<g-media>` block attributes 11. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockGMediaGroupAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockgmediagroupattributes.md) — checks `<g-media-group>` block attributes 12. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockGDescriptionAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockgdescriptionattributes.md) — checks `<g-description>` block attributes 13. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockGScriptAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockgscriptattributes.md) — checks `<g-script>` block attributes 14. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockGSwitchAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockgswitchattributes.md) — checks `<g-switch>` block attributes 15. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockGCaseAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockgcaseattributes.md) — checks `<g-case>` block attributes 16. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockGDefaultAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockgdefaultattributes.md) — checks `<g-default>` block attributes 17. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockGMapAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockgmapattributes.md) — checks `<g-map>` block attributes 18. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockGDivAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockgdivattributes.md) — checks `<g-div>` block attributes 19. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockGImportAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockgimportattributes.md) — checks `<g-import>` block attributes 20. [TemplateEngine.validateBlockGSpaceAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockgspaceattributes.md) — checks `<g-space>` block attributes 21. [TemplateEngine.validatePageAttributesBlock()](./gramstax.templateengine.validatepageattributesblock.md) — checks required attributes on `<g-*>` PAGE blocks (centralized) 22. [TemplateEngine.validatePageAttributeValuesBlock()](./gramstax.templateengine.validatepageattributevaluesblock.md) — checks value formats on `<g-*>` PAGE block attributes (centralized)

Errors from all validators are combined into a single result.

## Example


```typescript
const result = TemplateEngine.validateTemplate(`
  <g-base>
    <g-message>Hello {{name}}!</g-message>
  </g-base>
`);
// Result: { valid: true, errors: [] }
```
